player_prompt.intro: Ji̱n ŋar kɛ PegJump. Ɣɔki peek kɛl wi̱i̱ kɔam in dɔ̱ŋ rɛy puɔl mi ci thöl, kä woc pek päkä min ca ɣöth piny. Goal: thuɔ̱kdɛ ɛ la **kɛ̈ɛ̈** peg bi̱ duɔth thi̱n. Action format: cät '[4 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Thiɛlɛ mi̱ de laar i̱ /ciɛ jɛn. La̱tdɛ kɛ [i->j] .

outcome.win: Ca riali̱kä kɛ ɣöö ci mi dɔŋ duɔth thi̱n!
outcome.no_moves: /Thiɛlɛ mi̱ dɔŋ ti̱ bi̱ kɛn ɛ la̱t.
